title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
source: Set 2 Source (unconfirmed): AKG CE-1 > UHER CR-40 (cassette master audience);

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording of a killer ’82 second set with standout Stella Blue and a soaring Casey Jones encore
ai_review.review: The audience (Uher‑240) tape is remarkably clear despite a bit of wind noise and some upper‑mid‑range harshness, delivering an immersive listening experience that puts you right at the show. The performance itself is described as a “BAMF” second set with Jerry at his ’82 best, relaxed band chemistry, and memorable moments like Stella Blue, To Lay Me Down, Let It Grow and a Casey Jones encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and the recording quality (clear, immersive), yielding a weighted rating near 4.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear overall; minor wind noise and burnt‑edge upper mids noted, slight dip where tape flip occurs but largely transparent and immersive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is described as a BAMF performance with tight flow, relaxed vibe and strong segues; the encore adds extra excitement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised as being at his best for ’82 and delivering one of his finest performances.
